content: Turborepo recommended for small-to-mid TS/JS monorepos (5-50 packages), minimal learning curve, incremental adoption, pairs with pnpm workspaces. Nx better for large multi-team/polyglot repos needing code generation and architectural boundary enforcement. For a ~4-6 package repo (web, api, cli, mcp-server, shared packages), Turborepo + pnpm is the right-sized choice.
